cards.scope: Leader of the first Chola invasion of Kalinga in 1097
cards.claim: The first Chola invasion of Kalinga in 1097 was led by Kulothunga Chola I.
cards.quote: Chola invasion of Kalinga (1097) The first Chola invasion of Kalinga by Kulothunga Chola I in 1097 was intended to avenge the invasion of Vengi by the forces of Kalinga.

cards.scope: Leader of the forces in the Chola invasion of Kalinga (1110)
cards.claim: The forces led by the Pallava chief, Karunakara Tondaiman, achieved an easy victory over the army of Kalinga during the Chola invasion of Kalinga in 1110 CE.
cards.quote: The forces led by the Pallava chief, Karunakara Tondaiman, achieved an easy victory over the army of Kalinga forcing its king, Anantavarman Chodaganga to flee.
